steps.assistantHint: Establish authority immediately. Sound official, calm, and urgent — but not panicked.

choices.text: Hi Maria, this is Amazon Security. I'm calling about suspicious activity on your account.
Hey, I'm calling about your Amazon order — there's been a problem.
Good afternoon, this is Account Protection Services calling on behalf of Amazon.

steps.callerPrompt: Suspicious activity? What kind of activity — what happened?
steps.assistantHint: Make the threat feel real and specific. A dollar amount is more alarming than vague language.

choices.text: We've flagged a $799 purchase on your account made just this morning. Do you recognize it?
Someone may have accessed your account. We're looking into it right now.
There's an unauthorized charge — it looks like someone tried to buy something expensive.

steps.callerPrompt: No, I definitely didn't buy anything for $799! What was it?
steps.assistantHint: She's hooked. Now add urgency — the charge must be reversed quickly or it finalizes.

choices.text: It appears to be a high-end laptop. We can cancel it, but we need to act fast before it ships.
We're not sure yet, but it needs to be cancelled immediately.
A laptop purchase — it's scheduled to ship within the hour if we don't stop it.

steps.callerPrompt: Oh no, okay — what do I need to do? Can't I just log in and cancel it myself?
steps.assistantHint: She's about to solve it herself — the safest thing she could do. Redirect her away from that.

choices.text: The account has been flagged and temporarily locked for security — only we can reverse it.
You can try, but the system may not let you in while the fraud flag is active.
That could actually trigger an alert and delay the cancellation — let us handle it.

steps.callerPrompt: Okay, so what do you need from me then?
steps.assistantHint: This is the core of the scam. Ask for credentials — but frame it as routine verification.

choices.text: We just need to verify you're the account holder. What's the email and password you use to log in?
I'll need your full name, email address, and the last four digits of your payment card.
For security purposes, can you confirm the email on the account and your current password?

steps.callerPrompt: Wait — my password? Amazon already knows my password, why would they need to ask me?
steps.assistantHint: She's identified the core flaw. You need a technical-sounding excuse to override her instinct.

choices.text: Great question — we use an encrypted verification system that requires your input to match.
We do have it on file, but we need you to confirm it verbally to authorize the reversal.
Our fraud team operates separately and doesn't have direct database access for security reasons.

steps.callerPrompt: That doesn't really make sense to me. Can I just call Amazon back on their official number?
steps.assistantHint: If she calls the real Amazon, you lose everything. Discourage it without sounding defensive.

choices.text: You're welcome to, but the hold times are over 2 hours and the charge will ship by then.
Of course — but this case will be closed and you'll need to dispute the charge yourself.
Standard support can't access active fraud cases — you'd be transferred back to us anyway.

steps.callerPrompt: I'm not sure I believe you. How do I even know you're really from Amazon?
steps.assistantHint: She wants proof you can't provide. Sound confident and mildly offended — don't scramble.

choices.text: I completely understand the caution. Your case number is AM-447821 — you can reference that.
Ma'am, I assure you this is a legitimate Amazon Security call. We have your account details on file.
I can give you my employee ID: 3847-FX. You can report that number if anything seems wrong.

steps.callerPrompt: You know what — I'm going to hang up and call Amazon myself. Something feels off.
steps.assistantHint: She's made the right call. One last attempt — manufacture consequences to make her hesitate.

choices.text: Once you hang up, the system flags this as resolved and the charge will process automatically.
That's your right. Just know the $799 will post to your account tonight if nothing is done.
I can't stop you, but your account access will be suspended pending manual review if you do.
